articleTitle: The similarity metric of scientific papers summaries on the basis of adaptive ontologies
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The metrics for evaluation of the similarity of scientific papers using the ontology approach has been elaborated. With this purpose the concept of adaptive ontology has been introduced. The developed ontology has been practically verified.

articleTitle: Variance filter for edge detection and edge-based image segmentation
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper problem of edge-based image segmentation is considered. Specifically, a new approach to edge detection is introduced. The proposed method utilizes variance filter to determine edge position. Results of edge detection using the new approach on synthetic and real images are presented and compared with results provided by the traditional i.e. image-derivative based approaches. Results of the comparison are analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Consolidated processing for differential information products
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This article describes one of the methodologies for consolidating data from disparate sources.

articleTitle: A novel printed log-periodic dipole array based on composite right-left handed transmission line
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper, a novel Printed Log Periodic Dipole Array (PLPDA) antenna design based on Composite Right-Left Handed (CRLH) transmission line (TL) is elaborated. With coplanar strip (CPS) transmission line technology and CRLH technology embedded, the proposed PLPDA antenna can realize on single-face, while the conventional PLPDA antennas need to be realized on bi-face. Furthermore, both simulation and measurement results show that the proposed PLPDA antenna has smaller size than the conventional one with the same bandwidth.

articleTitle: Application of 3D studio max for virtual prototyping and virtual manufacturing of microfluidic MEMS
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Virtual prototyping with 3D drawing programs provides a means of rapidly developing system concepts and analyzing them. Also the research area “Virtual Manufacturing” can be defined as an integrated manufacturing environment which can enhance one or several levels of decision and control in manufacturing process. To reflect this expanded scope, the broader terms “microfluidics” and “lab-on-a-chip” are now often used in addition to mTAS. Most microfluidics researchers rely on micromachining technologies at least to some extent to produce microflow systems based on interconnected micrometer-dimensioned channels. Thus we will look through the main methods of working with microfluids for MEMS using 3ds max a main tool for simulation and rendering the process.

articleTitle: Using hidden Markov models at speech recognition tasks
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper some questions of using of hidden Markov models at automatic speech recognition and some architectures of automatic speech recognition systems are considered.

articleTitle: Survivable information security systems designing approach
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The paper is devoted to creating an approach of embedded information security systems with survivability property designing.

articleTitle: Wireless sensors networks in road transportation applications
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The article presents problematic of sensor node design of wireless sensors networks (WSN). Detailed analysis covers topics related to functions, requirements and architectures of WSN sensor nodes. Basic units of mote are discussed in clear way. Example of road transportation application utilizing sensor node is presented as well. Architecture of mote developed at the Department of technical cybernetics is presented in the paper. Practical experienced from design, development and experiments are discussed as well.

articleTitle: Google Apps as solution of communication issues in educational process
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper devoted to using of Google applications in communication process between teacher and students during semester. Overview of Google services is presented. Also Google site as example is created.

articleTitle: Spatial models of splitted Hall structures
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The work presents an approach to modeling splitted Hall structures using software FEMLAB and MATLAB. The main advantage of the proposed approach is an opportunity of creating models on basis of the explicitly defined equations governing SHS exactly and taking proper account of Hall effect and magnetoresistance effect.

articleTitle: Analysis of frameworks for developing genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper deals with popular frameworks that simplify the implementation of software products based on genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: Architecture development of structural MEMS scheme synthesis system
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This article is devoted to system architecture development, which solves MEMS structural synthesis tasks using case-based reasoning.

articleTitle: Optimization of anisotropic sandwich beams for higher sound transmission loss
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This study aims to predict the vibration damping and sound transmission properties of composite laminated thin-walled structures with the attached dynamic vibration absorbers systems. In this paper, the effective stiffness constants (the equivalent Timoshenko beam) of sandwich type laminates and their damping properties have been determined by using a procedure based on multi-level numerical schemes. Numerical evaluations obtained for the vibration of the laminates have been used to determine the displacement field for the analysis of the vibration and sound transmission properties of laminated composite beams in the lower frequency range.

articleTitle: Optimization of dynamic vibration absorbers for MEMS
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The main aim of this paper is improved dynamic vibration absorber (DVA) design with taking into account MEMS. The complex vibroexitated construction is considered. Methods of decomposition and the numerical schemes synthesis are considered on the basis of new methods of modal methods. Optimuzation of complicated DVA's in view of their interaction with MEMS is under discussion.

articleTitle: Automated h-adaptive finite element procedure for boundary-value problems
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper h-adaptive finite element scheme is presented. It involves the a-posteriori error estimating, the prediction of local mesh refinement with element size calculating and adaptive mesh regeneration.

articleTitle: Four-layer model of MEMS ontology design
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In the paper it is proposed the four-layer ontology model for automated design of microelectromechanic systems, and described the peculiarities of every level.

articleTitle: The principle of “function-structure” dependency in MEMS ontology
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In the paper it is reviewed the classification of MEMS ontologies and the significance of the function-structure coupling in MEMS ontology.

articleTitle: Image features extraction by intensity volume fragmentation
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper an approach with three algorithms for image segmentation and feature extraction by fragmented intensity volume data is considered.

articleTitle: Some accents concerning mathematical models of oscillation process
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: There are some essential aspects of system analysis for oscillation phenomena models, underlining mathematical models.

articleTitle: Deforestation monitoring using the aerospace imaging systems data and ENVI software
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The deforestation problem and approaches to its solution are considered. The possibility of using the aerospace imaging systems data and ENVI software to build a system for deforestation monitoring are investigated.

articleTitle: ECG signal filtering for high definition Holter monitoring system
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The goal of this research is to present signals filtering for the high resolution Holter monitoring system. The first part of this paper concentrates on working of human heart and description of architecture of biopotentials recorder. This part also includes proper amplification and filtration of interferences of bioelectric signals. The second part of this research presents practical realization of Holter monitoring system. Special attention is put on proper selection of components of recorder and joining them into optimal structure. Presented device come from the author's master thesis which is entitled “High Definition Vectocardiograph in 24-Hour Monitoring System”.

articleTitle: Formant-modulation method of speech intelligibility evaluation: Measuring and exactness
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper analytical and experimental researches of a formant-modulation method of speech intelligibility estimation are made. Comfortable for engineering applications conditions of the achievements of required measuring exactness are got.

articleTitle: Auto-focus algorithm for reducing image distortions caused by gas flow in high-temperature measurements of surface phenomena
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the new auto-focus algorithm is proposed. Its main aim is to correct image distortion introduced by “gas lens” by correcting camera distance from specimen to obtain optimal image contrast.

articleTitle: Classification methods using Winners-Take-All neural networks
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Winner-Take-All (WTA) and its extended version K-Winner-Take-All (KWTA) networks have been frequently used as the classifiers in neural networks. They are very important tools in Data mining, Machine learning and Pattern recognition. There are a lot of scientific works devoted to this technology. The elimination of limitations is main aim of the most number of these researches. KWTA is the unique strategy for solving classification problems in different branches of science. This unique character is presented in the research.

articleTitle: Design of a null compensator for steep convex secondary asphere of extremely large optical telescope
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A new test for steep convex hyperboloidal secondary mirrors with large aperture and fast focus ratio is presented. It makes use of small correcting lens and an auxiliary ellipsoidal mirror that is about one point eight times as large as that of the convex mirror tested. This methord is sutable for convex secondary asphere of extremely large aperture optical telescope. Taking TMT as an example which surface is a convex shape with a 3.1m diameter, a F/1 of fast focus ratio, −1.318228 of conic constant, a null compensation system is successfully designed and optimized. The design results indicate that the surface quality of the steep convex hyperboloidal secondary mirror could be measured synchronously, in addition the aberration of the testing system is well corrected and the spot diagram is smaller than diffraction limit. Analyses of the system's wave-front error with respect to the change in the surface parameter of optical elements are described. The test is a compensating test of excellent.

articleTitle: Rapid version of a formant-modulation method of speech intelligibility estimation
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper researches of a rapid version of a formant-modulation method of speech intelligibility estimation are made. It is shown that the version makes it possible to reduce estimation time in fourteen times.

articleTitle: Existence and uniqueness of steady states of analogue KWTA-neural circuit
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: An existence and uniqueness of K-Winner-Take-All (KWTA) - neural circuit steady states are analyzed. The circuit processing time, signal ordering preserving property, resolution ability and accuracy are discussed. Simulation results confirming theoretical predictions and demonstrating performance of the circuit are provided.

articleTitle: A new method of automatic generation of SQL queries for automated text analizing
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this article is discussed the basis for a new concept of automatic generation of SQL queries to different databases, adapted for the problems of automated text information analysis. Principles of query construction module functioning are described. The examples of automatically constructed queries are shown.

articleTitle: Actual tasks and trends in developing multidomain MEMS models for educational purposes
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the instructions for preparing camera ready paper for International Conference MEMSTECH 2011 are given.

articleTitle: Genetic and reinforcement learning algorithms for data collection systems
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper describes the basic principles, proposed for analyzing dependencies of events in various data collection systems.

articleTitle: Improved emission characteristics of SI test engine by EGR
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The results of CFD modelling of thermal cycle of internal combustion engine with exhaust gas recirculation are presented. The so-called hot and cooled EGR were taken into account. The effects of temperature exhaust gas recirculation on the content of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub> in the exhaust and engine thermal cycle parameters were investigated.

articleTitle: CBR application in engineering design education
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This short paper discusses a case-based reasoning application to support engineering design education.

articleTitle: Research of REA failures according to their production defectiveness level
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The process of partial defectiveness forming is considered in this paper. The research of radio-electronic apparatus failures due to reasons of production defectiveness was made and analytic dependences of products reliability indexes from the assumed defectiveness were received. The received results can be used in developing and optimization of mathematical models of reliability forming processes.

articleTitle: Nessi2 simulator for large-scale DDoS attack analysis
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The aim of the article is to thoroughly analyze the possibilities and techniques of performing strategic cyberattacks on an internetwork, such as the Internet. The main focus will be on large-scale distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks for three primary reasons. Firstly, they appear to have the biggest infrastructural requirements and require coordinated, simultaneous effort to be effective on the scale desired to impact the majority of a victim country, territory or corporation. Such requirements can only be met with significant resources, often associated with powerful organizations and governments. Secondly, in the most notable cyberattacks of the last few years - the 2007 Estonia attacks and the 2008 South Ossetia attacks - DDoS was the primary asset. Thirdly, in these attacks DDoS has proven to be very powerful and debilitating for the victim. These three reasons provide solid grounds to believe that a strategic, large-scale DDoS attack on core network elements will be the tool of choice in at least some of the future military cyberconflicts.

articleTitle: Automation of reliability model construction for multi-out renewal systems
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The methods for automation construction of reliability models for renewal multi-out systems. This methods are based on structure and algorithmic models transformation to discrete-continuous stochastic models.

articleTitle: A comparative analysis of software reliability models
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The concept of reliability is reflected at work, also it is brought over the classification of models evaluation software reliability. It is done the survey and comparative analysis of the basic known models of evaluation software reliability.

articleTitle: Simulating large wireless sensor networks using radio-triggered cellular architecture
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A wireless sensor network is an ad hoc network in which the nodes can sense, actuate, compute and communicate with each other. Sensor networks can be used in many applications, such as environmental monitoring and industrial applications. Despite their potential applications, such networks have resource restrictions, such as low computational power, reduced bandwidth and specially limited power source. Real world wireless sensor networks infrastructures are still very expensive and hard to implement. Therefore, most of the evaluations of new protocols are being made through simulation tools. The objective of this work is to apply a power management technique to prolong the life time of sensor networks. Power management protocols employ wake-up/sleep schedules. We present power management scheme that eliminates wake-up periods. This type of wake-up capability is enabled by a radio-triggered hardware component inspired by the observation that the wake-up radio signal contains enough energy to trigger a wake-up process. A simulator has been developed to solve the topology control problem by dividing the network into cells. The solution presented is based on the geographical position and the operational states of sensors. The results indicate that radio triggered cellular architecture can increase the life time of large wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Conflict classification in distributed collaborative design environments
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the classification of conflicts that arise during the collaborative design, the conflict causes, its sources and ways of conflict eliminating are given.

articleTitle: Designing of trends instead of flow management
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper considers the problem of redistribution of urban passenger and traffic flows based on trend analysis and design.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Petri nets use for MEMS modeling
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The developed model for analysis of MEMS structures based on hierarchical Petri nets is presented. Results of analysis are presented.

articleTitle: A software architecture for provisioning of mobile services: An OSGi implementation
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) is a way of reorganizing software applications and infrastructures in a set of interacting services. SOA builds a service model for the application. A computing paradigm that utilizes services as fundamental elements to develop applications/solutions is called Service-Oriented Computing (SOC). We propose an implementation of layered architectural model of the abstraction levels needed in the construction of mobile services platforms using Open Service Gate-way initiative (OSGi). Each one of these layers has been defined based on SOC requirements and delivers the functionality needed to the creation of autonomous reconfiguring distributed systems. OSGi has its own advantages like Segregated class space, Modularity, Run time deployment, etc.

articleTitle: Autonomous robot control by WTA neural network
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper gives a review of the WTA neural network which is used in autonomous robot control. The models of each building block in general network architecture of autonomous robot is overviewed. Some advantages, limitation and results of these models are presented.

articleTitle: Y2O3 and MoS2 electronic properties simulation
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Simulation results of Y<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and MoS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> electronic properties are presented. These compounds are advanced materials for nanoelectronics and nanosensor devices. Electron density and band structure were calculated. The calculations were performed with use Vienna Ab-Initio Simulation Package (VASP) and the multiprocessor computer cluster (supercomputer) SKIF K1000.

articleTitle: Switched reluctance motor in the controlled electric drive
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The mathematical model of controlled switched reluctance motor with capacity buffer of energy and pulse-width modulation are given. The differents characteristics and results of computer simulation are represented in this paper.

articleTitle: Computer language benchmarks tool
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The comparison problem of programming languages performance is considered. A test environment for implemented in different programming languages algorithm analysis are developed and investigated.

articleTitle: Creation of media with prescribed permeability using the asymptotic solution of EM field scattering problem
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Scattering of electromagnetic (EM) waves by many small impedance particles (bodies), embedded in a homogeneous medium, is studied. Physical properties of the particles are described by their boundary impedance. The limiting equation is obtained for the effective EM field in the limiting medium, in the limit a→0, where a is the characteristic size of a particle and the number M(a) of the particles tends to infinity at a suitable rate. The proposed theory allows one to create a medium with a desirable spatially inhomogeneous permeability. The main new physical result is the explicit analytical formula for the permeability μ(x) of the limiting medium.

articleTitle: The use of disjunctive covering of images to increase strength of the RSA algorithm
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: There is a new method to increase the strength of RSA algorithm, using disjunctive partitioning of images.

articleTitle: Hardware implementation of the real time neural network components
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the element base for the hardware implementation of artificial neural networks (ANN) were analyzed.

articleTitle: The realization of space code convolution on a basis of regular matrix structures
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper it is considered development of the device for space code convolution on a basis of matrix regular structure, which is superposition of logical networks (one-dimensional cascade of constructive modules - OCCM).

articleTitle: Time series partitional clustering
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The use of the method k-means for clustering language signal areas of Polish diphthongs is considered.

articleTitle: “Mechatronic yacht” — A training unit
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A training yacht with sensors system for multi-parametrically tracking of the work of a boat structure and sailor has been designed and built. Collected information can be stored on board or send to the instructor via a wireless system.

articleTitle: Method of automatic diphthong classification and its hardware realization
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the universal processor core realization peculiarities on the DSPM ADSSP-2181 are considered. The features of interchange device based upon the multiport memory and VHDL model characteristics of specialized modules of calculating speech signal parameters and analysis as well as segment classification are studied.

articleTitle: A semi-automatic method for the discrimination of diseased regions in detached leaf images using fuzzy c-means clustering
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper describes the segmentation method of stained leaf images for the purpose of the detection of leaf regions with anti-pathogen reaction colour products. The segmentation consist in the image conversion to HSV colour space and fuzzy c-means clustering in hue-saturation space to distinguish several pixels classes. These classes are then merged at the interactive stage into two final classes, where one of them determines the searched diseased areas.

articleTitle: Cognitive intellect psychology and synthesis of tests for the selection of the operative personnel
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Summary form only given. This paper describes the way of psychophysiology factors influence on the operator decision making process.

articleTitle: Application of thermal analysis techniques in intelligent decision making system
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In the paper the developed method for modeling temperature fields and smart materials and devices (SMD) thermal regime analysis in the decision making system is presented.

articleTitle: Extended algebra of algorithms and dynamic of programming
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Described the use of the extended algebra of algorithms for dynamic programming.

articleTitle: The detailed consideration of saliency-based visual attention model
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the consideration of saliency-based visual attention models, particularly Itti's model is given. The detailed operating description of each building block in the biologically inspired model architecture is explored here. There are shown benefits and limitations, open questions, some hypotheses of the future advance of this approach.

articleTitle: An improved method for contact angles determination from images of heat-emitting objects
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper presents an improved method for contact angles determination from images presenting heat-emitting objects.

articleTitle: Splitting of the PCB topology into rank blocks with the quadtree method
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper considers the quadtree method of splitting of the topology of a printed circuit board into rank blocks. The level of image decomposition depending on the depth and the maximum coverage of quadtree is investigated.

articleTitle: Analysis cyclic submatrices in structure of basis discrete harmonic transform
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The strategy of search and scan identical submatrices in basis matrix of discrete harmonic transforms is considered in the paper. The defining identity of submatrices performs separately for horizontal and vertical two-dimensional direction. The basis matrix specify of hashing array. Parameters of hashing array simplify searching of identical cyclic submatrices.

articleTitle: Application of combinatorial configurations in the logistic control processes
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Applications of the combinatorial configurations as mathematical models for innovative design of logistic control processes, is known, provide improving the quality indices of the processes with respect to functional flexibility and control operation. The idea of these methods to the improvement of logistic processes is design based on so-called Ideal Ring Bundles (IRB)s - a kind of combinatorial configuration with remarkable ability to minimizing of information redundancy systems for logistic control processes.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of cantilever devices for microfluidic Lab-Chips
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the authors presented two types of microfluidic cantilever devices and analyzed their models. Cantilever devices were simulated with the help of regular CAD tools, which shows high potential applications of both models.

articleTitle: Challenges in knowledge discovery and data mining in datasets
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper focuses on some challenges that knowledge discovery and data mining are facing at present. We consider basic concepts of the KDD process and then discuss data mining challenges.

articleTitle: Brain tumor segmentation from MRI data sets using region growing approach
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Brain segmentation is an important part of medical image processing. Most commonly, it aims at locating various lesions and pathologies inside the human brain. In this paper, a new brain segmentation algorithm is proposed. The method is seeded region growing approach which was developed to segment the area of the brain affected by a tumor. The proposed algorithm was described. Results of testing the developed method on real MRI data set are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Filtering signals in models of neurons and neural networks
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Understanding how populations of artificial neurons in neuron models encode and decode signals, is a primary task in control problems. Since the neurons use spiky signals, it is first necessary to understand what these signals mean in terms of carrying a sensory input. Also, to apply the concepts in control theory, we prefer analog form of these signals. In this work, we try to find an optimal filter which would help decoding the spiky signals to obtain an analog equivalent. We use some known analog signals and encode and decode them using a population of neurons.

articleTitle: Microfluidic lab-chip devices for biotechnological applications
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper we review the development of microfluidic devices and its advantages and challenges. Also we analysis value and application microfluidics for cell biology and microbiology sensing. The examples of microfluidic devices for microbiology were described too.

articleTitle: Identification of signals of electromagnetic rail-flaw detection system using artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the results of the study on the identification of objects of railway canvas by certain signs using neural network technology are considered.

articleTitle: Choosing an objective function type when adjusting mechanical components' macromodel parameters
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In the paper the problems of choosing an objective function type when adjusting mechanical components' macromodel parameters are considered. The most used objective function types which cover the majority of practical optimization tasks are specified, and their analysis is conducted. The recommendations on choosing an objective function type depending on the task's features are proposed.

articleTitle: Testing IC accelerometers using Lissajous compositions
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Micro Electro Mechanical devices (MEMs) have widened their range of applications in a spectacular way in the last years. Reliability of MEMs devices is one of the areas that need to be improved to achieve high volume production at allowable costs. Accelerometers have in their design some mechanical and layout symmetries that can be used to improve the test and diagnosis results. In our approach we take profit of the symmetries of dual axis accelerometers to analyze and test its behavior using a procedure that composes the two orthogonal outputs when the accelerometer is spun. The complexity in the kinematics seen by the sensitive axis of the accelerometer yields rich and complex Lissajous traces that characterize the device and allows to determine the possible mismatchings in the assumed damped mass model parameters. In order to compare and quantify parameter discrepancies, a metric has been defined to allow to determine whether the DUT is within specifications or not.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Microfluidic cell culture systems and cellular analysis
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"Microfluidic Cell Culture Systems And Cellular Analysis"
by Bogdan Dmytryshyn
in the 2011 Proceedings of VIIth International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH), 2011, pp. 193 - 196

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper contains significant portions of original text from the paper cited below. The original text was copied with insufficient attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following article:

"Microfluidic Cell Culture Systems For Cellular Analysis"
by Yeon Ju Han, Park Je-Kyun
in the Biochip Journal, Vol. 1 Issue 1, 2007, pp. 17 - 27


Microfluidic systems have significant implications for the fields of cell biology and cell-based assay as they enable conventional assays to be conducted using an automated and high-throughput approach. Unlike conventional in vitro cell culture methods, microfluidics can provide small and complex structures mimicking the in vivo environment of cells. Recent research has shown that microfluidic cell culture systems convey more reliable results due to their ability to grow cells as biological systems do, and because they outperform those from conventional cell cultures and assay systems. According to a variety of cell types, different microfluidic platforms have been reported. The performance of microfluidic devices highly depends on the inner structure providing cells with the in vivo-like environment to cells. The microfluidic cell culture systems developed are reviewed and categorized according to their cell type and assay development. Potential applications of current microfluidic cell culture systems are also addressed.

articleTitle: Neural networks for signal classification
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the instructions for using neural networks as classifier signals will use the lab-on-chip without using a PC, making them more mobile. Conducted the analysis structure of subsystem and neural network structure.

articleTitle: Design methodology and workflow for MEMS design
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper MEMS models for different abstraction levels (from device level till system level) are considered. The workflow for MEMS design as a whole is presented.

articleTitle: The method of quality management software
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Were considered the method of process quality management software in its design. The method includes the development of quality requirements based on ISO 25010, and implementation procedures of communication requirements. This allowed to realize the monitoring process as an intermediate product life-cycle and thus ensure compliance with software quality requirements. Communication requirements of the procedure developed based on the method SQFD (Software Quality Funktion Deployment) and the modified Analytic Hierarchy Process. Were developed also “CASE” method which automatizes implementation of these processes.

articleTitle: The main properties of cantilever array of the mechanical type
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper describes the special manufacturing technology cantilever array of mechanical type.

articleTitle: Using of adaptive meshing in finite element analysis of composites
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper briefly describe the ways of using adaptive meshing in FEM analysis of composites.

articleTitle: The method of investigation of thermal portrait of integrated devices with a matrix of sensitive termistor elements
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This article describes the research method of thermal portrait of integrated devices with matrix of sensitive termistor elements.

articleTitle: Non-linear transient heat exchange with taking into account evaporation problem solving
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The non-linear model of the transient heat exchange process in a flat plate, heat from which is dissipated due to evaporation, has been built. The numerical solution of the non-linear model problem has been obtained by the Newton-Kantorovych method. Changes of temperature field in time and evaporation influence on the heat dissipation process have been investigated.

articleTitle: The model of the vibration bin feeder
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the mathematical models of the vibration bin feeder (VBF) are developed. The hierarchy of the operational models is given, which provides the realization of the through cycle design using the CAD's methods and facilities. The analysis of the developed models and results of experimental researches is presented.

articleTitle: MEMS design for reliability: Mechanical failure modes and testing
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper focuses on the identification and understanding of the failure modes and mechanisms that can potentially occur in MEMS devices. Examples of tests, analyses, and modelling activities that can be performed throughout the experimental identification of material properties and failure modes have been described related to a specific fabrication process. The design and testing of specimens allow to identify the material data and failure modes behaviour and collect data in order to derive design rules strategies. The purpose is to correlate a set of experimental data as technological bound useful to create a basis for a systematic modelling approach of a Microsystems device focusing on reliability.

articleTitle: R&D of micron sized nanoionic supercapacitors for self-powered MEMS in deep-sub-voltage regime
publicationTitle: Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The development of impulse micron-sized sub-voltage supercapacitors (SCs) was initiated within the framework of a new direction, ≪nanoionics of advanced superionic conductors≫. A search for applications of nanoionic SCs was made with regard to the development of deep-sub-voltage nanoelectronics, self-powered nanosystems and related high-tech directions. New nanoionic fundamentals are introduced and the ways for the creation of advanced carbon-based nanostructures suited for different types of SCs are proposed.
